title: Answers stay right and correctly cited
goal: The pack index's unit cache never reuses stale weights after a weighting change and tests pin it; check.py refuses a ledger path:line citation that points at a line that is no fact; the held-out eval holds no row that rewords a tuned eval row and refuses one that does; land runs the contract lint when a landing changes articles; and the two user-asked gaps, prompt-caching pricing and GitLab CI job log timestamps (FF_TIMESTAMPS), pack good
